title: Special Needs Plans: Qualifying Need, Authoritative Source and Confirmation Intervals by Plan Benefit Package
content:
Every plan benefit package in the Special Needs Plans category is approved for one special need. This annex records, package by package, the need the package is built for, the authoritative source that need is confirmed from, the Medicaid categories that qualify a member where the package rests on Medicaid, and the three intervals the package fixes: how long a prescriber's attestation holds good, how often the need is confirmed again, and how many months a member keeps the plan after losing a qualifying Medicaid status.

## 1. Need and authoritative source

| Plan benefit package | Kind of special need | Qualifying need | Authoritative source the need is confirmed from |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | dual eligible | entitlement to both Medicare and Medicaid | the monthly state Medicaid eligibility file |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | dual eligible | entitlement to both Medicare and full Medicaid benefits | the monthly state Medicaid eligibility file |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | chronic condition | a diagnosed cardiovascular disorder | a prescriber attestation confirmed against the member's claim history |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | chronic condition | diabetes mellitus | a prescriber attestation confirmed against the member's claim history |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | chronic condition | a chronic lung disorder | a prescriber attestation confirmed against the member's claim history |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | institutional | residence in a long-term care facility for the qualifying period | a completed institutional level-of-care assessment |

## 2. Medicaid categories that qualify a member

| Plan benefit package | Qualifying Medicaid categories |
| --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | qualified Medicare beneficiary; specified low-income beneficiary; qualifying individual; full benefit dual |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | full benefit dual |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | none |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | none |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | none |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | none |

## 3. Qualification and continuation intervals

| Plan benefit package | Days of institutional residence required to qualify | Days a prescriber's attestation holds good | Months between confirmations of the need | Months the plan is kept after a qualifying Medicaid status is lost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | 0 | 0 | 1 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | 0 | 0 | 1 | 6 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 0 | 60 | 12 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 0 | 60 | 12 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | 0 | 60 | 12 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | 90 | 0 | 6 | 3 |

## 4. Conditions of entry common to every package

Besides the qualifying need set out above, a member must be entitled to Part A, must be enrolled in Part B, and must have their permanent residence in the service area. These three conditions of entry are carried by every plan benefit package in the Special Needs Plans category alike, whatever its kind of special need.

## 5. Basis of each column

- **Kind of special need.** Which kind of Special Needs Plan the package is: dual eligible, chronic condition or institutional.
- **Qualifying need.** The special need a member must have to hold the package.
- **Authoritative source.** The source the qualifying need is confirmed from.
- **Qualifying Medicaid categories.** The Medicaid categories that qualify a member for the package.
- **Institutional residence.** Days of institutional residence a member must have to qualify for an institutional package.
- **Attestation validity.** Calendar days a prescriber's attestation of the chronic condition holds good while the plan confirms it.
- **Confirmation interval.** Months between confirmations of the qualifying special need.
- **Continuation after loss of status.** Months a member keeps the plan after losing their qualifying Medicaid status.

## 6. Reading a row

Taking Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP): the package is a chronic condition package built for a chronic lung disorder, and that need is confirmed from a prescriber attestation checked against the member's claim history. Such an attestation holds good for 60 days, the need is confirmed again every 12 months, and the package carries 0 days of institutional residence and 0 months of continued holding after a qualifying Medicaid status is lost.

Taking Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP): the qualifying need is residence in a long-term care facility for the qualifying period, that period being 90 days, and it is confirmed from a completed institutional level-of-care assessment. The need is confirmed again every 6 months, and the package carries 3 months of continued holding after a qualifying Medicaid status is lost.
